dct_description_sm: XRF data are presented in counts per second (cps); Land use data are presented in % of the catchment area; Chlorophyll a is presented in mg/L; Total phosphorus is presented in ug/L; Specific conductance is presented in us/cm at 25 degrees Celsius; Dissolved oxygen is presented in % saturation; Area is presented in square kilometers; Altitude is presented in metres; Max depth is presented in metres; activity midpoint depth is presented in cm relative to the core top; Unsupported Pb210 and Pb210 error is presented in Bq/kg; Supported Pb210 and Pb210 error is presented in Bq/kg; Inventory and inventory error presented in Bq/square meter.

Micro-X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) Core Scanning data (i.e., elemental composition) and ancillary lake and watershed data for 90 Canadian lakes collected as part of the LakePulse program between 2017-2019. Includes radioisotopic data for determining sediment ages.
dct_title_s: XRF core scanning data and ancillary lake and watershed data for 90 Canadian lakes [2017-2019]
